name: linux-hotspots
description: Static hotspots for 'bench.py spin' (one spot, camera turning in laps, settings flipped live), worst first by the evidence in docs/research.md and docs/benchmark.md. Every place, hour and weather is copied from an existing scenario; the scene comments say which and why. The scenes are ordinary static scenes, so 'run --scenario linux-hotspots' works too.

blackwood-wayshrine.comment: Point 20 of blackwood.json's blackwood-flight path (about 1.6k units south of the Wayshrine of Stendarr), turned along the path

silver-road-climb.comment: First point of silver-road-upper's path (point 79 of silver-road-north), turned along the path (the road climbing north)

scenes.comment: 1 (lowest fps measured). Stock 30.6 fps at 720p (research.md, 'The bottleneck chain in Cheydinhal': canal noon 30.6, dusk 32.2, night 34.1 vs chapel square 44.7 and inn front 53.3); the CPU-limited town view that the render/RHI-thread fixes were built on. Dusk and night variants: cheydinhal.json canal-dusk / canal-night.

2 (crowd cost). The Imperial City market district's own population at 10:00 with the shops open (actors.json ic-market-morning; docs/benchmark.md scenario 'actors': 'many characters'); the view used for the crowd-bound tests of the translate-job cap in research.md (rejected ideas table).

3 (creation bursts). Beside Peryite's Shrine (npcburst-visual.json shrine-near) with its five robed worshippers: the NPC creation/cloth burst of 4-5 frames of 40-97 ms stock (research.md, 'Far-away characters created a piece per frame', Peryite rows 89-98 -> 41-51 ms). Standing here exercises their steady cost and LOD/cloth; the burst itself is a travel event (npcburst.json peryite-flight).

4 (creation bursts, forest pop-in). Blackwood forest at dusk just south of the Wayshrine of Stendarr: Sheogorath's Shrine worshippers are created as cell row -22 attaches, 55-72 ms frames (blackwood.json description); dense forest foliage on the GPU scene.

5 (streaming hitches). The Silver Road climb north of Roxey Inn (silver-road-upper.json): 25-40 ms frames at fixed spots while cells, navmesh and NPCs stream (research.md, 'Area-loading order'). A spinning view streams the terrain/LOD in the same way each lap.

6 (night fps + stutter). Outside Roxey Inn at 23:00 looking west along the road: reported in play 2026-10-09 at ~45 fps before frame generation with stutters at 4K (roxey-night.json; docs/benchmark.md scenario 'roxey-night').

7 (GPU-bound foliage/water). The pond by Fort Doublecross in the rain, late afternoon (gpu-check.json, the kit's Check-GPU; leyawiin-forest.json): GPU-heavy foliage, water and weather. Note: gpu-check uses profile 'own'; spin uses the scenario/--profile default.

8 (milder town view). Chapel square at noon: 44.7 fps stock vs 56.6 with the render fixes at 720p (research.md, canal/chapel table); the second Cheydinhal view for comparing a setting at a spot with less CPU pressure than the canal.
